description:
Spline is a 3D design tool that enables designers to create, animate, and publish interactive 3D web experiences. With a real-time collaborative editor and intuitive interface, Spline makes 3D creation accessible for web, UI, and motion designers.

Spline is a free 3D design software with real-time collaboration to create web interactive experiences in the browser. Easy 3d modeling, animation, textures, and more.

3D Modeling: Build shapes and scenes easily. Animation: Animate objects and scenes with keyframes. Interactivity: Add triggers and user actions. Collaboration: Edit projects in real time with others.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Access Editor
howToUse.description: Create a free account on Spline to access the online 3D editor.

howToUse.title: Create or Import a 3D Scene
howToUse.description: Start a new project or import 3D assets. Use the intuitive interface to add, modify, or arrange objects.

howToUse.title: Animate & Add Interactivity
howToUse.description: Use keyframes to animate objects and add triggers for user interactions (clicks, hovers, etc.).

howToUse.title: Collaborate in Real Time
howToUse.description: Invite others to edit your project simultaneously for team-based workflows.

howToUse.title: Export or Publish
howToUse.description: Export your project as web-embeddable content or share a public link for interactive viewing.
